reference: consensus_contact, source and candidate frozen in data/control_boundary_v1

promotion.all_pairs: No stitched spellF1 loss; D recall >=reference-.02; no extra mostly missed stoppages; MacroF1 >=reference-.005. No previously mostly recovered short true run may become mostly missed.
promotion.each_buffered_seed: spellF1 >=reference+.01; strictly fewer false D frames; strictly larger mean best same-label IoU of true live runs <=125 frames.
promotion.selection: Among passing finalists prefer lower buffered false D, then larger mean short IoU, retaining seed42. Disclose every block regression. If none passes keep the current default.

interpretation: Methods and thresholds frozen after seed42 screen; remaining seeds are dependent adaptive stress checks on the same public possessions. No new settings after this freeze.
